120	export function updateEntities(dt, player, magnetRadius) {
121	  let coinsCollected = 0;
122	
123	  for (const coin of coins) {
124	    if (coin.collected) continue;
125	    coin.spinAngle += dt * 3.2;
126	
127	    const cx = coin.x + 8;
128	    const cy = coin.y + 8;
129	    const px = player.x + player.w / 2;
130	    const py = player.y + player.h / 2;
131	    const dx = cx - px;
132	    const dy = cy - py;
133	    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
134	
135	    // Magnet pull
136	    if (dist < magnetRadius && dist > 4) {
137	      const pull = 280;
138	      coin.x -= (dx / dist) * pull * dt;
139	      coin.y -= (dy / dist) * pull * dt;
140	    }
141	
142	    // Collect
143	    if (Math.abs(dx) < player.w / 2 + 10 && Math.abs(dy) < player.h / 2 + 10) {
144	      coin.collected = true;
145	      addCoinParticles(cx, cy);
146	      coinsCollected++;
147	    }
148	  }

151	  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
152	    const p = particles[i];
153	    p.x += p.vx * dt;
154	    p.y += p.vy * dt;

156	    p.life -= dt;
